visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a beige hoodie and glasses is sitting cross-legged on a light wood-colored floor, assembling the base of a dark green artificial Christmas tree. Beside him, two young girls are present: one wearing a beige plaid top with a white collar and the other in a red sweatshirt with a cartoon character. In the background, large white beanbag chairs and a sunlit window are visible. (2) The scene shifts to the girls choosing ornaments from a pile on the floor. One girl in red picks up a small silver bell-shaped ornament while another in a yellow sweater vest holds a small brown pouch. The man assists them in hanging various colorful spherical and metallic decorations onto the tree's branches. The floor is cluttered with boxes and packaging. (3) The man lifts the girl in the plaid top into the air. She holds a large, intricate golden star ornament with both hands. He brings her close to the top of the tree so she can carefully place the star on the highest branch. They are both smiling and appear focused on the task. (4) In a dimly lit room, the three girls are sitting on the floor in front of the fully decorated Christmas tree, which is now illuminated with warm yellow fairy lights. The background shows a cozy living room with a couch and toy storage. The girls look towards the camera with expressions of wonder and excitement. (5) The setting changes to a bright, daylight-filled living room. Numerous wrapped gifts in red and pink paper are scattered at the base of the Christmas tree. A girl in a red sweater approaches the tree excitedly. She begins to pick up a large rectangular gift wrapped in red polka-dot paper and carries it away. (6) The girls are now unboxing their presents on the floor. One girl pulls out a large grey shark plushie with a white belly. Another girl receives a red and yellow water bottle shaped like a cartoon character. A third girl examines a board game in a colorful box with wooden pieces. The floor is covered in torn wrapping paper and discarded ribbons.
